definitions: What someone does is more important and shows their true intentions and feelings more clearly than what they say.
It is better to do something than just talk about it.
examples: Don't just tell me you'll help; actions speak louder than words.
She promised to change, but actions speak louder than words, and she's still doing the same things.
He keeps saying he's sorry, but actions speak louder than words, and he hasn't done anything to make amends.
synonyms: put your money where your mouth is
